records.title: Potassium level changes in chronic kidney disease patients following balanced crystalloid administration in the emergency department
records.context: One common reason why clinicians are often hesitate to administer balanced crystalloids in the emergency department is the potential occurrence of unexpected hyperkalemia in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD). In order to investigate the changes in potassium levels resulting from the administration of balanced crystalloids, specially Plasma Solution A (a generic version of Plasma-Lyte), to emergency department patients with CKD, we conducted an evaluation. A retrospective cohort study was conducted at a single academic hospital. Our study included patients with CKD who received intravenous Plasma Solution A and underwent electrolyte follow-up testing within 24 hours of administration.
